decisions.reason: The firm has invested in the encrypted secondary channel and publicly promoted it as part of its secure communication direction, so sunk costs and commitment make dropping unlikely.
The multi-layer security architecture is central to the firm's identity and security infrastructure and has received a dedicated public page, increasing escalation pressure to persist.
The QR-code hardware token builds on established authentication expertise and has been publicly presented, so management will likely justify continued support rather than write off the investment.
The payment security compliance suite leverages existing security assets and aligns with regulatory needs, and dropping it would expose earlier commitment as a mistake.
